name: How long does a wrongful death lawsuit usually take to resolve?
description: The resolution time for a wrongful death lawsuit varies, from under a year for simple cases to several years for complex ones requiring trial.

mainEntity.name: How long does a wrongful death lawsuit usually take to resolve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a wrongful death lawsuit can vary significantly depending on the complexity of the case, the willingness of parties to negotiate, and court schedules. Simple cases might settle within a year, while more complex disputes involving multiple parties, extensive evidence, or a need for trial could take several years to resolve. Your attorney can provide a more accurate estimate after reviewing the specifics of your situation, but patience is often required.
